case.summary: Petitioner seeks to modify an existing joint-custody order after the other parent relocated 90 miles away without notice, disrupting the agreed school-week schedule. The child is 8. Petitioner wants the primary weekday schedule formalized so the child can stay enrolled in their current school.
case.reliefSought: Modification of the custody order to designate petitioner's residence for school enrollment and adjust the weekday parenting schedule.

timeline.event: Original joint-custody order entered; alternating weeks.
Other parent moved ~90 miles away without prior notice.
Child began missing school days due to long commute on the other parent's weeks.
Petitioner proposed a revised schedule by email; no agreement reached.

evidence.description: Existing 2024 custody order showing the alternating-week schedule.
Attendance log showing 11 absences/tardies since the move.
Email thread where petitioner proposed a new schedule and the other parent declined.
